description: Edit repos/goal-host-vessel/src/index.ts so the walk supplies the successor-feature readout inputs that activity-api's discover-by-shapes service requires. At every fetch to /v2/activities/discover-by-shapes that already sends include_scores: true, also send `signature` (set to the same cached state signature hash currently sent as state_signature) and `completion_shapes` (set to the walk's goal target shape array). The service destructures `signature` and `completion_shapes`; sending only `state_signature` and `expected_output_shapes` leaves both guard conditions false, so the psi transfer value is never computed. Also add completion_shapes alongside the existing expected_output_shapes on the /v2/activities/recommend request bodies.
